'''H4V-1K''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] present on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
H4V-1K appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor, selling the contract required to unlock [[Treek/Legends|Treek]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
